options.name: value
options.description: PlainDate for date granularity; Instant for minute granularity.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name for the ISO 8601 hidden input.

options.name: trailing
options.description: Advanced: element appended inside the group boundary after the segments (used by Date Picker for its calendar button). Focus moving into it does not mark the field touched.

options.name: formControl
options.description: Advanced, read at creation: false skips registration with Form, for composite controls such as Date Picker that register themselves.

options.name: disambiguation
options.description: DST policy for nonexistent/ambiguous local times.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer-provided host (children are owned by the component).

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current valid value, or null when empty/invalid.

properties.name: validity
properties.type: { valid: boolean; error: DateInputError | null; localTimeStatus: 'exact' | 'ambiguous' | 'nonexistent' | null }

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

properties.name: localValue
properties.description: Minute granularity: the complete wall-clock date and time in the segments, even when the zone rejects it; else null.

methods.name: setLocalValue
methods.description: Minute granularity, for composite controls: write a wall-clock date-time resolved as if typed (timezone, disambiguation, DST hint or error). No aui-change.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; init-only options throw.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove listeners, subscriptions, and rendered children.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user changes the value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: ISO 8601 value (YYYY-MM-DD or instant with Z), or null when empty or invalid.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { value: PlainDate | Instant | null; validity: DateInputValidity }
events.description: User edit changed the value or validity.

cssClasses.name: aui-date-input__description | __hint | __error
cssClasses.description: Help, timezone/DST hint, and error text.
